name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-expert-finder
title: Expert Finder
shortDescription: Find colleagues by skill, explore profiles and availability, and request introduction drafts or confirmed Teams meetings in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
longDescription: An SPFx 1.24.1 Copilot UX component that renders an expert directory inline and in fullscreen using React, Fluent UI v9 and a SharePoint Experts list.
Explore local filters, delegated Graph photos and free/busy availability, confirmed calendar-backed Teams meetings, and selected-profile introduction drafting in the Copilot conversation.
A missing Experts list selects bundled fictional profiles with local portraits. Mock profiles make no Graph calls; Schedule remains a preview and live meetings require explicit confirmation.

thumbnails.alt: Expert Finder architecture: Copilot invokes a typed SPFx tool that renders a React directory using SharePoint or fictional profiles, with optional Graph actions and introduction drafting.
